evidence.role: Both settlement states converge on a live ownership read and exact caller comparison before redemption state changes and burn.
The inherited owner lookup resolves the current `_owners` ledger entry and rejects nonexistent or burned tickets.
ERC-721 updates replace the live owner on mint, transfer, and burn, so redemption does not use a historical owner snapshot.
The NFT and cash delivery branches both occur after the common owner-only gate.
